label: Distance i Total distance traveled. Can be entered in kilometers or miles.
Speed i Average speed of travel. Can be entered in km/h or mi/h.
Work Output i Total mechanical work done during exercise in Joules. Include all reps and weights lifted.
Squat Weight i Maximum squat weight lifted. Used to auto-calculate your Strength Score relative to body weight.
Body Weight i Your current body weight. Used to calculate the Strength Score.
Number of Pull-Ups i Enter the maximum number of consecutive pull-ups you can perform with proper form.
Number of Push-Ups i Enter the maximum number of push-ups you can perform in one set with correct form.
Distance i Total distance you ran. Can be entered in kilometers or miles.
Sleep Duration (hours) i Enter your average nightly sleep. Recommendations depend mainly on age and individual circumstances.
Weight Lifted i Enter the maximum weight you can lift for the chosen exercise (e.g., bench press, squat) with proper form.
Training Duration i Enter total training time per session (in hours by default).
Rest Duration i Enter total rest or recovery time between sessions (in hours by default).
Distance i Total distance you walked. Can be entered in kilometers or miles.
Weight Lifted i Total weight lifted per repetition. Include body weight if part of the movement. Enter in kg or lbs; conversion is automatic.
Distance Moved i Vertical distance the weight or your body moves per repetition. Enter in meters or feet; conversion is automatic.
